item.title: SPIRITBOX Drops Surprise New Single 'Mourning,' First New Music Since 2025's 'Tsunami Sea'
item.description: Spiritbox have returned with “Mourning,” their first new song since 2025’s Tsunami Sea, and the single sounds less like unfinished business from that album than an early look at whatever the Canadian metal band intends to build next.

item.title: EUGENE ABDUKHANOV On MESHUGGAH's Early Days: 'People Didn’t Get It Then'
item.description: Eugene Abdukhanov isn’t new to giving credit where it’s due, even if it takes the rest of the world a couple of decades to catch up.
